text: Wields a <color=#fcbe03>Frost Staff</color>, excelling in <color=#fcbe03>long-range combat</color>. Commands the power of ice to deliver <color=#fcbe03>wide-area DMG</color> and formidable <color=#fcbe03>control</color>.
